import hashlib, subprocess, os
try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageSequence, ImageChops

g={}

    print("  ",k[:8],len(v),v[:8])
W,H=frames[0].size
st=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H*len(frames)),(255,255,255,255))
for i,f in enumerate(frames): st.paste(f,(0,i*H),f)
st.save('../work/stack_all.png')
su=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H*len(g)),(255,255,255,255))
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(g.items()): su.paste(frames[v[0]],(0,i*H),frames[v[0]])
su.save('../work/stack_uniq.png')
acc=frames[0].convert('L').copy()
for f in frames[1:]:
    acc=ImageChops.darker(acc,f.convert('L'))
acc.save('../work/union.png')
